items.label: Patented Bulge for Lower Back Targeted Support
items.value: AUVON Team has collaborated with physical therapists to innovate ergonomic office desk accessories with an innovative precision support design. Based on ergonomic theories, the scientific position and thickness of the bulge can offer a natural fit to the lumbar spine structure to relieve lower back pain from long sitting

items.label: Ergonomic Zoning Design for Lumbar Comfort
items.value: This desk chair cushion is crafted with 4 ergonomic zones to cradle your back for long-sitting relief. The upper curved zone can fit your upper back with contoured comfort. The lower support zone is designed with high-density memory foam for targeted support. The wrap zone of both sides conforms to your lumbar for pressure distribution. There is also a pelvic support zone on the underside of this back support pillow

items.label: Breathable and Cool Sitting Relief
items.value: Crafted with a honeycomb breathable fabric and integrated with mesh side stitching, this office chair pillow for back support can deliver ventilation with lasting freshness. Even after prolonged sitting, the posture corrector keeps your back cool and comfortable from sweating and stuffy feelings

items.label: Stay-Put Design
items.value: The dual straps and the anti-slip backside can make the lumbar support cushion remain firmly in place for continuous support comfort. Say goodbye to constant and hassle sliding and readjustments with this back support pillow for office chairs

items.label: Shows You Care with Daily Comfort
items.value: Dimensions:18"x 15"x 4.5",making it ideal for individuals weighing between 100 lb and 200 lb. Ideal for office workers, drivers, gamers or anyone you love who sits for long hours. It improves posture, relieves fatigue, and fits most chairs. Ideal choice for Christmas,New years, birthdays, Valentine's day, Mother's day, Father's day, weddings, Hallows' day and graduations

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Foam core is non-washable., When cleaning the removable cover, zip it up to protect it from damage and follow the care label instructions. Be sure to machine wash cold separately using a gentle cycle and tumble dry on low heat
